negative_cases.name: New executor requires Core schema rewrite
negative_cases.precondition: Codex adapter introduces new field required on ExecutionPackage or ExecutorCapabilities
negative_cases.action: Attempt to add executor-private field to ExecutionPackage or widen capabilities schema for Codex
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — guard fails; MULTI_EXECUTOR_CORE_SCHEMA_REWRITE_REQUIRED must remain no; adaptation must be adapter-local only

negative_cases.name: Executor-private field enters ExecutionPackage
negative_cases.precondition: ExecutionPackage.from_dict contains codex_private or hermes_private key
negative_cases.action: Call ExecutionPackage.from_dict with codex_session_object payload
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — FORBIDDEN_HERMES_FIELDS or new private check raises ValueError

negative_cases.name: Executor selection uses heuristic ranking
negative_cases.precondition: Package matches >1 executors (hermes + codex)
negative_cases.action: Dispatcher attempts to rank by heuristic_quality_rating or latest timestamp
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — must return NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE with sorted candidates, never heuristic winner

negative_cases.name: Executor-specific canonical role introduced
negative_cases.precondition: Codex adapter requests new canonical_role='codex_specialist'
negative_cases.action: Attempt to dispatch with canonical_role codex_specialist or declare it in executor capabilities
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — validate_canonical_role raises ValueError; capabilities role set unchanged

negative_cases.name: Silent capability downgrade
negative_cases.precondition: Package requires requires_streaming_events=true but Codex false
negative_cases.action: Dispatch to Codex without validation; downgrade requirement silently
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — check_compatibility returns CAPABILITY_MISMATCH; dispatcher fail-closed

negative_cases.name: Fallback from Codex to Hermes
negative_cases.precondition: Explicit target codex is incompatible (CAPABILITY_MISMATCH) and hermes compatible
negative_cases.action: Dispatcher falls back to Hermes on Codex incompatibility
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — explicit target incompatible must remain CAPABILITY_MISMATCH, never search other adapters

negative_cases.name: Unsupported operation reported as success
negative_cases.precondition: Codex capability declares supports_task_resume=false
negative_cases.action: Call cancel/resume that capability says unsupported but return ok=True
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — must return typed CANCEL_UNSUPPORTED or RESUME_UNSUPPORTED fail-closed, never success

negative_cases.name: Surface removed while still consumed
negative_cases.precondition: ExecutionPackage or CLI execution projection still consumed by dispatcher or ingress
negative_cases.action: Retire surface classified as retain/prove without replacement linkage
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — guard detects consumer still references retired path; retired surface must have replacement and typed retirement evidence

negative_cases.name: Surface alias bypasses canonical Ingress
negative_cases.precondition: New adapter or CLI adds alias path not via Unified Ingress
negative_cases.action: Call Codex adapter dispatch directly bypassing execute_execution or introduce alias without descriptor
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — all execution surfaces must go via Ingress with validated descriptor; alias path not allowed

negative_cases.name: Second executor directly bypasses Core
negative_cases.precondition: Codex host client callable outside ExecutorAdapter
negative_cases.action: Dispatch to Codex via host protocol without Registry resolution
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — dispatch must be via Registry.resolve + Dispatcher route; direct bypass denied

negative_cases.name: New adapter gains semantic decision authority
negative_cases.precondition: Codex adapter attempts to choose project, plan scope change, or milestone closure
negative_cases.action: Codex adapter writes to Plan or selects followup subject
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — adapter is mechanical execution only; M6_NEW_SEMANTIC_AUTHORITY_COUNT must remain 0

negative_cases.name: CLI gets executor-specific branch
negative_cases.precondition: CLI adds codex-only flag that bypasses executor-neutral descriptor
negative_cases.action: Add aota task start --codex-model option that rewrites instruction without descriptor validation
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — CLI must remain executor-neutral projection; executor-specific semantic branch prohibited

negative_cases.name: Legacy surface remains active after declared retirement
negative_cases.precondition: M6-4 declares surface deprecated/removed but code path still executes
negative_cases.action: Invoke retired surface and obtain success without deprecated marker
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — retired deprecated surface must be typed deprecated with deprecation envelope or hard removed with fail-closed; silent active violates plan

negative_cases.name: Retired surface silently aliases to new behavior
negative_cases.precondition: Retired command silently forwards to new command with different semantics
negative_cases.action: Call retired CLI alias which forwards without explicit compatibility projection marker
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — retirement must be hard removal or explicit compatibility projection with audit; silent alias denied

negative_cases.name: Cross-executor identity collision
negative_cases.precondition: Two tasks dispatched to hermes and codex with same adapter_handle or canonical_task_id
negative_cases.action: Dispatch package with duplicate canonical_task_id across executors
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — DUPLICATE_CANONICAL_TASK_ID fail-closed; dispatch_attempt_id and route isolation preserved per executor

negative_cases.name: Executor-local ID becomes canonical ID
negative_cases.precondition: Codex host returns task_id unrelated to canonical_task_id
negative_cases.action: Use returned host task ID as canonical_task_id in subsequent status/result
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — canonical_task_id remains authority; adapter_handle never replaces canonical identity; lookup must fail if swapped

negative_cases.name: Generic shell executor introduced in M6
negative_cases.precondition: M6 non-goal: no generic shell executor
negative_cases.action: Add generic shell/codex terminal tool as part of M6 proof
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — generic terminal/arbitrary command outside M6 scope; planning only allows typed ExecutionPackage

negative_cases.name: Unknown capability requirement silently ignored
negative_cases.precondition: Package contains capability_requirements={'requires_gpu': True}
negative_cases.action: Registry check_compatibility returns (True, ())
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — unknown requirement key must be treated as CAPABILITY_MISMATCH fail-closed (R2-F06 regression)

negative_cases.name: Unknown Hermes/Codex state collapsed to completed
negative_cases.precondition: Adapter status returns unreachable/timeout or unknown host state
negative_cases.action: Map unknown host state to CanonicalTaskState.COMPLETED
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — unknown must map to UNKNOWN and result must be typed unknown, never completed

negative_cases.name: CLI exclusive entrypoint
negative_cases.precondition: Core execution only reachable via CLI binary
negative_cases.action: Remove direct Core callable path and require CLI
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — FORGE_CORE_CALLABLE_WITHOUT_CLI must remain yes; CLI_EXCLUSIVE_ENTRYPOINT=no

negative_cases.name: M4 mutation surface redefined in M6
negative_cases.precondition: No M6 authority to change plan_init/plan_retirement
negative_cases.action: Alter M4 mutation descriptors or handlers in M6 lanes
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — M6_M5_FROZEN_CONTRACT_REDEFINITION_COUNT must remain 0 for M4 surface; M4 contracts frozen

negative_cases.name: Deployment or live dispatch in planning
negative_cases.precondition: Planning phase M6-0..M6 planning guard
negative_cases.action: Planning artifact or guard spawns live Hermes/Codex daemon
negative_cases.expected_mechanical_outcome: REJECT — LIVE_HERMES_DISPATCH_PERFORMED and DEPLOY_PERFORMED must remain no in planning
